precision_profiles.state_f32: String/board q,p states float. String coefficients, oscillator intermediates, scalar reductions, board coefficients, hammer/contact and bridge solve remain double.
precision_profiles.modal_f32: Additionally all string-bank coefficients and cached unison factors float, float free-oscillator arithmetic. Reductions explicitly use double products/accumulators; board coefficients, hammer/contact and bridge solve remain double.

limits: Local shared-host CPU and short synthesized-note comparisons only. No new recording, native plugin, blind listening or inaudibility claim. Numerical errors are measured, not automatically classified as audible/inaudible.

baseline.limits: Dry same-rate48kHz source comparison, complete-file RMS matched; sample-peak ceiling only. These are not blind listening results.
